{{Top|leg}}
'''Team Zhaboka''' was a missile battalion formed from the remnants of [[Rusher's Brigade]] that had survived the [[Battle of Gazzari]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. The other surviving unit [[Team Ripper]] was formed from a merger of personnel from [[Ripper Battalion]] and [[Coyn'skar Battalion]]. It saw action during the [[Siege of Calimondretta]].
